title: Reunion of Siblings
next_chapter_hook: As the footsteps of His Highness's Grand Tutor drew closer, Chen Ji gripped Chen Nian's hand and made his final decision—at the entrance to the seventh layer of the Forbidden Grounds, an earth-shaking chess game was about to unfold.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was weighing the pros and cons, a faint yet clear call echoed from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds—it was Chen Nian's voice. And her gaze, clear and sharp, sent a chill through his heart.\n\nChen's foot froze mid-step, his heart skipping a beat. Ten years. This voice had appeared in his dreams countless times, yet never as vivid as this moment. The surrounding darkness of the Forbidden Grounds seemed to recede as he rushed toward the source of the sound.

dialogue.content:
"Brother..."

The words slipped from Chen Nian's lips, carrying ten years of hardship and restraint. She stood in the faint light deep within the Forbidden Grounds, her form thin yet straight as a pine. The稚嫩的面容 once childish features were now angular and defined, but those eyes remained as clear as ever—the proof of their blood connection.

Chen's throat tightened slightly, yet his feet stopped three feet away. Ten years. These two words had pressed against his heart for a full decade.

text.content:
The cold of the Forbidden Grounds seeped into his bones, yet Chen Ji was oblivious. He stared fixedly at this familiar yet foreign face, countless images flashing through his mind—the rainy night ten years ago when Holy Sect disciples forcibly took Chen Nian away, her final backward glance.

That gaze held no fear, only a commission.

Tonight, that gaze contained far too much he could not understand.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his voice low: "These ten years... how have you been?"\n\nThough he had thousands of words to ask, at this moment only these words emerged. And his hand hanging at his side trembled slightly—that was suppressed emotion.

Chen Nian shook her head lightly, a bitter smile curling at her lips: "Alive."\n\nTwo words, light as a feather, yet heavy as a thousand pounds. She stepped forward, closing the distance between Chen Ji to mere inches, her eyes gleaming with an unusual light in the darkness: "Brother, there are things I must tell you now—about the Chen family, about the Tianji Record, about the true mission in our bloodline."

text.content: Before her words could finish, the Tianji Record suddenly trembled violently. Chen Ji下意识 pressed his hand to his chest, feeling a scalding force surge from those incomplete pages, rushing straight toward his heart. That was blood resonance—siblings who hadn't seen each other for ten years, now separated by the void, yet had formed some mysterious connection.\n\nPage four. The fourth page of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian's pupils dilated sharply, and a pale golden dragon mark appeared above her brow, resonating with the Tianji Record's fluctuations: "It's calling to me... Brother, your Tianji Record is responding to the dragon vein key within me!"\n\nHer voice carried a hint of urgency: "This is the first secret I've discovered—the Tianji Record never belonged to the Tianqing Sect. It's our Chen family's ancestral life-bound artifact!"

text.content: These words struck like thunder, exploding in Chen Ji's mind. He stared fixedly at the dragon mark on Chen Nian's brow, its pattern identical to the one on his Tianji Record's cover—same origin, same root.\n\nChen family's ancestors... that legendary existence actually had such a connection with the Tianji Record? And he, this so-called "waste," had been a chosen piece from the very beginning?

dialogue.content: The ink characters on the first page of the Tianji Record rippled slightly, and Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a weight of solemnity: "She speaks the truth. Before Chen Xuan's fall, he entrusted the Tianji Record to the Tianqing Sect to deceive others. The true inheritance... has been waiting all along for the Chen bloodline's return."\n\nAfter a pause, he added: "And the dragon vein key within her body is the key to opening the fourth page. Without her, you will never glimpse the complete truth."

Chen Nian drew a deep breath, her expression grave: "But this is not everything. Brother, the Holy Sect imprisoned me for ten years not just because of the dragon vein key—they want what's behind the key."\n\nShe paused, her voice dropping even lower: "For the dragon vein to fully awaken, it requires the Chen family's bloodline to unseal the binding personally. And once the seal within me loses control, not only will I die—the entire Holy Sect will be destroyed by the dragon vein's power!"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Looking at Chen Nian's emaciated form, he suddenly realized what she had endured these ten years—she was not merely a captive prisoner, but a living bomb that could detonate at any moment. The Holy Sect treated her as a tool, never caring for her life or death.\n\nA surge of killing intent churned in his chest, yet Chen Ji forcibly suppressed it. This was not the moment for rashness.

dialogue.content: Chen Nian seemed to sense his emotional turbulence, suddenly stepping forward, clasping Chen Ji's wrists with both hands. Her fingertips were ice-cold yet resolute: "Brother, I have a plan."\n\nHer eyes blazed with unwavering determination: "His Highness's Grand Tutor's men are in pursuit, time is running out. Let me cooperate with you in an act—I want to fake my death, making them believe the dragon vein key has been destroyed. Only this way can we buy ourselves breathing room."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's proposal threw Chen Ji into a dilemma—he knew time was scarce, yet absolutely could not allow his sister to risk her life. The blood bond allowed him to sense Chen Nian's resolve, but also caught the fear and unease hiding beneath that resolve.

choices.text: Agree to the fake death plan
choices.description: Trust Chen Nian's judgment, cooperate with her in an act, use her "death" to draw away His Highness's Grand Tutor's pursuers, seeking true survival in the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian must endure tremendous pain and risk
choices.visible_reward: Fight for precious time, fully activate the fourth page of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Once the acting reveals flaws, or His Highness's Grand Tutor sees through the deception, the consequences would be unthinkable

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then turned and clasped Chen Nian's hand tightly. Her hands were cold and thin, yet they conveyed a warmth unchanged through ten years. He stared into his sister's eyes, speaking each word deliberately: "Alright. I trust you."\n\nThree words, bearing the weight of countless burdens. He said nothing more, only pressed the Tianji Record close to his chest, and the seal on the fourth page began slowly loosening.

choices.description: Absolutely forbid Chen Nian from risking her life, even if time is tight we must find a safer plan, even if the cost is losing this chance to escape.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss this good chance to escape, His Highness's Grand Tutor's pursuers will get closer and closer
choices.visible_reward: Protect Chen Nian, not letting her bear the risk of fake death
choices.risk_hint: Time waits for no one; when will the next opportunity come?

dialogue.content:
"No." Chen Ji's voice turned cold and sharp, yet his grip on Chen Nian's hand tightened further. "Ten years ago, I failed to protect you. This time, I will never let you bear this alone again."

His gaze was sharp as a blade: "Feigning death is too dangerous. If something happens to you, what's the point of me escaping? There must be another way."

choices.description: Neither fully refusing nor accepting, proposing to take greater risks himself while allowing Chen Nian to cooperate within controllable limits.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji needs to consume more Heavenly Fate to buy time
choices.visible_reward: Both protect Chen Nian and allow the plan to continue advancing
choices.risk_hint: Massive consumption of Heavenly Fate will cause Chen Ji to fall into weakness

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly, and he suddenly said, "The plan is feasible, but the details need some adjustment."

He lowered his voice and quickly deduced the situation: "I will arrange the feigned death—using the Tianji Record to create the illusion of a 'Dragon Vein backlash.' Your identity cannot be exposed, otherwise the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor will immediately realize this is a trap."

text.content:
At that moment, heavy footsteps echoed from deep within the Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji's expression instantly grew grave—those were footsteps of cultivators, uniform and disciplined, at least ten or more.

The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's men had already entered the seventh level.

dialogue.content:
A flicker of anxiety crossed Chen Nian's eyes. She tightly gripped Chen Ji's sleeve: "There's no time! They're faster than I anticipated—"

Before she could finish, the dragon pattern mark on her brow center suddenly flickered intensely, and a berserk power overflowed from within her. Chen Nian groaned, kneeling on one knee, her face instantly turning as pale as paper.

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He caught Chen Nian and could feel the berserk power within her losing control—that was the stress response of the Dragon Vein Key after sensing danger. If not suppressed quickly, not only would Chen Nian suffer backlash, but their location would be completely exposed.

The Tianji Record trembled again, the seal on the fourth page burning like fire against Chen Ji's chest, as if urging him to make a choice.

dialogue.content:
"Brother..." Chen Nian's voice was weak but persistent, "Use the Tianji Record... right now, you're the only one who can help me suppress this power... but you will pay a price..."

Her eyes were full of struggle and guilt: "I don't want to be your burden... but now... we have no way out..."

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's life hangs by a thread, the signs of Dragon Vein losing control becoming increasingly obvious. The Tianji Record burns against the chest, as if urging Chen Ji to make a decision quickly.

choices.description: Without hesitation, activate the Tianji Record's power, using Heavenly Fate as the cost to suppress the Dragon Vein turmoil within Chen Nian, even if it means damaging himself.
choices.visible_reward: Completely suppress the Dragon Vein loss of control, activate the fourth page seal, obtain the complete content of the Chen family ancestors' testament
choices.risk_hint: Low Heavenly Fate may trigger Tianji Record backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment. He slammed the Tianji Record onto Chen Nian's brow center and low shouted: "Contain!"

In an instant, a brilliant golden light burst from the pages, flowing along his arm into Chen Nian's body. The berserk Dragon Vein power retreated step by step under the golden light's suppression, and was finally resealed back into Chen Nian's brow center.

choices.description: Without relying on the Tianji Record, but using the Chen family's bloodline instinct to guide the Dragon Vein. Although more dangerous, it won't consume Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji will endure the danger of Dragon Vein backlash
choices.visible_reward: Establish deeper trust in Chen Nian's heart, showcasing the true power of the Chen family's bloodline
choices.risk_hint: Backlash may cause Chen Ji to temporarily lose combat capability

text.content:
Chen Ji abruptly bit through his fingertip, pressing the bleeding finger onto the dragon pattern mark on Chen Nian's brow center. A scalding power surged from the depths of his bloodline—that was the Chen family's natural affinity for the Dragon Vein.

Golden light and blood-colored radiance intertwined, and the Dragon Vein's turmoil gradually subsided under this dual power.

The golden light faded, and Chen Nian awoke slowly. Her first sight was Chen Ji's pale complexion and slightly trembling fingers—her eyes instantly grew moist: "Brother, you again sacrificed for me..."

Chen Ji shook his head, his voice somewhat hoarse: "Don't speak. Listen."

Footsteps drew nearer and nearer.

Chen Nian nodded forcefully, forcing herself to stand. The siblings stood back-to-back deep within the forbidden grounds, the surrounding gloom seeming to gain life as it swirled around them. The seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record had been completely broken; a truth sealed for ten thousand years was slowly emerging.

The true遗命 of the Chen family's ancestor was about to be revealed.

And the pursuers of the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor were already at hand.

The golden light of the fourth page slowly unfolded before Chen Ji's eyes—it was a遗命 written in ancient characters. The moment he看清内容, his entire body felt struck by thunder—

「I am Chen Jitian, the founding patriarch of the Chen family. The Tianji Record is not a prophetic artifact, but... the chain that imprisons the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Ten thousand years ago, I divided that transcendent consciousness into nine parts, sealing each within one of the nine bloodlines. The Tianji Record is both the key and the core of the seal.」

「Descendants who inherit the Tianji Record should know—the Eye of Heavenly Dao has never perished. It has been waiting for the moment when the nine bloodlines reunite and reshape its physical form. Only then can the Chen bloodline utterly destroy it.」

Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. So from the beginning, the Tianji Record was not merely the ability to foresee the future, but a mission spanning ten thousand years. The secret the Chen family had guarded for generations was actually the imprisonment of the most terrifying existence in this world.

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian seemed to sense something too; a flash of understanding flickered in her eyes: "So... the Dragon Vein Key within me is not just a treasure sought by the Holy Sect, but one of the nine fragments sealing the Eye of Heavenly Dao?"

She murmured softly: "No wonder they would spare no expense to control me... What they want is not merely power, but to use the Dragon Vein Key to complete the reshaping of the Eye of Heavenly Dao!"

Chen Jiabruptly turned his head, meeting Chen Nian's gaze. They both saw the same terrifying possibility in each other's eyes—the true purpose of the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor was probably far more dreadful than they had imagined.

text.content:
At this moment, a sinister voice drifted from the darkness: "Who would have thought, the little Chen whelp actually found this place."

The figure of the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor slowly emerged from the shadows, behind him followed more than ten deep-breathing experts. His gaze swept over the Dragon Mark between Chen Nian's brows, a greedy smile curling his lips: "The Dragon Vein Key... and the Tianji Record. What a double blessing."

Chen Ji shielded Chen Nian behind him, killing intent blazing in his eyes. This old thing, as expected from the start, had been plotting against them.

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's hand, her voice urgent yet clear: "Brother, the plan changes—don't fight head-on."

She took a deep breath; the Dragon Mark between her brows glowed faintly again: "Let me draw them away. Take the Tianji Record and go—only you can fulfill our ancestor's遗命."

Chen Ji was about to refuse when she cut him off: "This is the only way! The Dragon Vein is within me, they won't kill me easily—but you are different. You are the master of the Tianji Record; they will definitely root out the source!"

Her eyes reddened, yet she smiled withrelieved: "Ten years ago you failed to protect me—this time... let me protect you."

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's forces had completed their encirclement; Chen Nian's proposal left Chen Ji torn—he would never abandon his sister, but reason told him Chen Nian's analysis was correct.

choices.description: Never accept any plan that lets Chen Nian take the risk alone, even if today's outcome is mutual destruction, the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor must pay the price.
choices.visible_cost: Both may fall into a desperate situation
choices.visible_reward: Brother and sister side by side, advance and retreat together
choices.risk_hint: The enemy is many, we are few; the situation looks grim

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji spun around abruptly, hands pressing onto Chen Nian's shoulders, his gaze blazing: "Listen carefully. Ten years ago I failed to protect you—that is my greatest regret in this life. But from now on, my life, Chen Ji's life, is your life—live together, die together."

His voice was cold yet firm: "I would rather die fighting here than let you face these wolves alone."

choices.description: Grievingly agree to Chen Nian's plan, letting her draw away the enemies while I take the Tianji Record and the ancestor's遗命 to seek a counterattack opportunity.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian will face danger alone, and it is unknown when we will meet again
choices.visible_reward: Preserve the Tianji Record's inheritance, creating a chance to turn the tables in the future
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may encounter misfortune while luring the enemies

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji remained silent for a long while before finally nodding with difficulty. He took a jade pendant from his bosom and pressed it into Chen Nian's palm—the only贴身 item he possessed: "Crush it, and I can sense your location. Whatever happens... you must survive."

His voice trembled—this was the first time in ten years he showed emotion before others: "Wait for me. This time, I will come find you."

choices.text: Activate the Tianji Record for a final desperate gambit
choices.description: Consume all remaining Heavenly Fate Value, to foresee the sole chance of survival in the next three hours—an unexpected variable that no one anticipates.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value may drop below the dangerous threshold
choices.visible_reward: Foresee the sole chance of survival, completely turning the tide of the situation
choices.risk_hint: The consequences of depleting Heavenly Fate Value are unpredictable

text.content:
A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he made his decision. He raised the Tianji Record high above his head, murmuring: "Tianji Record—Full Open!"

In an instant, the air around him twisted, countless golden runes poured from the pages, forming a barrier between him and the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor. And within his pupils, the various possibilities of the next three hours were reflected—

He saw a fleeting opportunity.

The prophecies of the Tianji Record surged into Chen Ji's mind like a tide. He saw it—three breaths later, an expert behind the Prince Taishi would be distracted by a mechanism beneath the ground; thirty breaths later, the Dragon Vein in the Forbidden Grounds would undergo a strange transformation due to Chen Nian's proximity; three hundred breaths later, an ancient seal from antiquity would be triggered, dragging everyone here into an unknown vortex.

This was the opportunity he had been waiting for.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips. He leaned close to Chen Nian's ear and whispered: "Three breaths later, the person on the left will be distracted. Follow me."

Before the words even finished, he had already pulled Chen Nian like a ghost, darting to the left. At that exact moment, the stone beneath that expert's feet behind the Prince Taishi suddenly gave way. He let out a startled cry, his body stumbling—the very scene Chen Ji had foreseen.

text.content:
"Chase!" The Prince Taishi howled, taking the lead in pursuit.

However, at this very moment, the entire Forbidden Grounds began to shake violently. The dragon pattern mark on Chen Nian's brow center erupted with blinding light, resonating with some sleeping existence deep beneath the earth. A boundless force surged from the ground, sending everyone staggering.

Chen Ji's heart tightened—the Dragon Vein had awakened ahead of schedule!

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian's face instantly paled, but she gritted her teeth and steadied herself: "Brother, this is the moment—the Dragon Vein's disturbance has captured everyone's attention, we can—"

Before she could finish, a fierce sword qi came slashing from behind. Chen Ji dodged to the side, taking the blow in his embrace. He turned to see the Prince Taishi's face contorted with rage, his long sword glowing with an eerie purple light: "Trying to run? Dream on!"

The sword qi approached, yet Chen Ji remained utterly composed. He had already seen this scene in his foresight.

text.content:
Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian behind him, his right hand reaching out as the pages of the Tianji Record rustled loudly. A golden barrier formed before the two of them. The Prince Taishi's purple sword qi collided with the barrier, scattering brilliant light across the sky, yet it could not advance even an inch.

"Is this the power of the Tianji Record?" The Prince Taishi's pupils constricted, then he狞笑着 grinned wickedly: "Unfortunately for atrash like you, how long can you sustain this?"

A mocking curve appeared at the corner of Chen Ji's lips. He offered no answer, merely uttering a single word: "Explode."

The golden barrier shattered abruptly, transforming into countless blades that shot outward in all directions. The Prince Taishi was forced back several steps, while Chen Ji had already dragged Chen Nian into the deeper darkness.

They ran for who knows how long before the surrounding scenery gradually changed. The幽暗 dim passage vanished, replaced by an expansive underground space. Countless glowing crystals were embedded in the dome above, outlining the silhouette of a giant dragon—the very source of the Dragon Vein.

Chen Nian abruptly stopped, her expression complex as she gazed at that massive dragon head fossil: "Brother, we've arrived. This is the core of the Dragon Vein... and also the starting point where our ancestors sealed the Eye of Heavenly Dao."

Chen Ji gripped her hand tightly, feeling the resonance transmitted through their bloodline. The content from the fourth page of the Tianji Record overlapped with the scene before him, as a long-buried memory was awakening.

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian suddenly turned around, cupping Chen Ji's face with both hands, her eyes glistening with tears: "Brother, there's something I must tell you."

Her voice carried a tremor: "During the ten years at the Holy Sect, they have constantly tried to unravel the seal of the Dragon Vein within me. Every time they failed, they would vent their frustration on me... but I never yielded."

She took a deep breath, her smile carrying a sense of release: "Because I knew, you would definitely come to rescue me."

Chen Ji's heart ached. He wanted to say something, yet found his throat blocked as if by something. Ten years... his younger sister had endured a full ten years in the clutches of those wolves, while he could only pretend to be atrash, advancing carefully step by step.

text.content:
Chen Ji reached out, gently wiping away the tear at the corner of Chen Nian's eye. His movements were clumsy yet tender—this was the first time in ten years he had touched his sister's cheek.

"I'm late." His voice was hoarse, "But from now on, no one shall lay a finger on you again."

Chen Nian laughed through her tears, grasping his hand in return: "I believe you."

Just then, a thunderous boom came from behind. The Prince Taishi's forces had already caught up to the entrance, and their only escape route now was that ancient seal radiating幽光 eerie light in the depths of the Dragon Vein core.

Chen Ji gazed at that seal, the content from the fourth page of the Tianji Record resurfacing in his mind. His ancestors' dying command echoed in his ears—

「Only when the Nine Veins reunite as one can the Eye of Heavenly Dao be reshaped; only when the Nine Veins remain scattered can it be sealed forever.」

Now that the Dragon Vein key within Chen Nian had awakened, what would happen if she entered the sealing grounds? Would it trigger the Eye of Heavenly Dao's rebirth, or open a new seal?

He didn't know. But one thing he was certain of—the Prince Taishi must never learn this secret.

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian seemed to realize something as well. Her gaze fell upon that seal, her expression growing solemn: "Brother, something inside there... is calling to me."

She paused, lowering her voice: "I can feel it, that is the meaning of my existence."

Chen Ji gripped her hand tightly, his gaze firm: "Whatever lies within, we face it together."

The siblings smiled at each other, as if the ten years of separation had never existed. They turned around, facing that eerie light ahead, and also facing the fate that approached.
